verdict.rationale: Cline documents per-edit diffs that can be reviewed, modified, or reverted in the editor, and Plan mode lets you explore before changes are applied (cline-gh-1, cline-docs-11), which covers diff inspection well. However, dedicated 'run checks' functionality (e.g., automated test/lint gating before merge) isn't explicitly documented beyond generic headless CI/CD execution capability, and no hands-on evidence confirms a structured pre-merge check workflow. Missing for 10: explicit test/lint/check-running workflow tied to diff review, independent corroboration of diff-review accuracy in real PR workflows, CI-specific check-gating documentation.
